verdict.rationale: Evidence confirms configurable notification rules and escalation (schedules, escalation policies, REST API control over 'how they're notified') and a community report describing PagerDuty's actual multi-channel behavior (app push first, then phone call if unacknowledged), supporting the core capability. However, no evidence pack item explicitly documents SMS or email as distinct notification channels, nor shows the granular per-channel rule-configuration UI. Missing for 10: explicit documentation naming all four channels (push, SMS, phone, email) and detailed per-channel rule configuration screens/API fields.
